name: Sierra Biomed - Autoclave and Medical Equipment Service and Repairs
old_description: Our Vision is To provide Peace of Mind for SPD managers, OR Managers and Biomed Departments by ensuring the highest reliability of equipment and being a one-call service provider for all SPD equipment
about:
Based in Aston Township, Pennsylvania, Sierra Biomed has spent more than four decades building a service organization focused on sterile processing equipment. The company operates across seven states from the Philadelphia–Washington corridor, deploying field service engineers who handle everything from routine inspections to emergency breakdowns.

Sierra Biomed does not manufacture equipment; instead it provides a single-source service model that covers preventative maintenance, emergency repair, installation, and the sale of both equipment and consumables. The firm maintains what it describes as the largest in-house inventory of preventative-maintenance and repair parts in the region, enabling a 93 percent first-time fix rate and a guaranteed 24-hour on-site response for emergencies. In 2025 its technicians logged more than 270,000 service miles across 485-plus customer sites.

The customer base includes hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, pharmaceutical firms, and laboratories. One named reference is SurgCenter of Towson, which relies on Sierra Biomed for sterilization equipment uptime. The company also serves biomedical departments and sterile processing managers who need consolidated contracts across multiple original equipment manufacturers.

Sierra Biomed says its differentiation lies in a 'one-call' capability that eliminates the need for multiple vendor contracts, a customer portal that provides real-time access to service records and job sheets, and a commitment to transparent communication backed by a 'make it right' guarantee if service falls short.
